title: Degree of a sum of translates
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ whose algebraic degree is $d$, and let $y,y'$ be points of that cube. The function $x\mapsto f(x+y)+f(x+y')$, with addition over $\mathbb{F}_2$, has algebraic degree at most $\max(d-1,0)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$
